correctness.rationale: Directed-forest model is exact for incidence matchings of octahedral graph K_{2,2,2}. Independently enumerated 5^6 partial parent choices, discarded every cyclic case, recovered face vector (1,24,228,1072,2496,2304). Rebuilt pivot matching, checked 2724 pairs and the directed Hasse graph of 25176 incidences by topological sort: exactly one critical vertex and 675 critical four-cells. Independently recomputed signed Lefschetz traces of all 48 signed-permutation automorphisms, yielding ten class traces (-25,1,-1,-5,1,-9,675,-15,-3,3) in the specified class order. Average is 11 fixed dimensions, inversion trace -25 gives eigenspaces 325 and 350. The wreath-product irrep induction formula used to recover multiplicities was separately checked against the small symmetric-group character tables and the full character, not inferred from the nonequivariant rank.

evidence: General equivariant Morse theory constructs homotopy-preserving complexes of groups for compatible matchings, not these graph-specific 48 character values.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A general construction for all finite group actions does not provide the evaluated octahedral character without the significant fixed-face calculation.
